finalText:
The bug was in the `isExpired` function. It used `<` instead of `<=`, so when the expiry time equaled the current time, it returned `false` instead of `true`. The code comment says "A token is considered expired the moment `exp` is reached," which means the comparison needs to include the equal case.

Changed `token.exp < nowSeconds` to `token.exp <= nowSeconds`. All five tests now pass.
